paragraphs: The X4 xDrive20i is a petrol variant of the first-generation F26 X4. Earlier cars use the N20, while later cars use the B48. These are different engine families with different component and service requirements, so we confirm the exact engine by registration before quoting.
about.boldParagraph: The X4 xDrive20i is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.

compatibility.intro: Because BMW X4 xDrive20i can use the N20 or B48 engine code, fitting the wrong replacement risks a compatibility problem that's expensive to unpick. Before we quote or supply anything, we confirm:

points.text: Your exact engine code (N20 or B48) via registration or VIN
Any electronics or ECU considerations specific to your exact build

compatibility.footer: This is why we always start with your registration rather than a generic X4 xDrive20i quote - it protects you from paying for parts that don't fit your actual car.
